category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: No scalp-problem positioning; general balanced scalp route. Dry lengths/curls do not imply dry scalp.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: CAPB #3 plus Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate #4 and Coco-Glucoside #19 form a mild amphoteric/isethionate/nonionic wash system, with Glyceryl Oleate #11 as a refatting counterbalance. Effective anionic cleansing is present, but no sulfate/olefin reset chassis supports strong; low is preferred to moderate within the INCI-only uncertainty. Observed intensity: gentle.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: normal — Mild cleansing plus moderate care/deposition supports normal-diameter hair without the richest coating architecture. coarse — Moderate rinse-off care and mild cleansing support coarse-diameter hair; shampoo alone is not claimed to replace conditioning. Conditional (not emitted): fine — Bounded persistent conditioning plus mild reset may reduce movement on fine hair; suitable finish/dose is unknown, so do not promote binary ideal yet.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: CAPB #3 plus Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate #4 and Coco-Glucoside #19 form a mild amphoteric/isethionate/nonionic wash system, with Glyceryl Oleate #11 as a refatting counterbalance. Effective anionic cleansing is present, but no sulfate/olefin reset chassis supports strong; low is preferred to moderate within the INCI-only uncertainty.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: Cationic guar #17 plus Glyceryl Oleate #11 and Glyceryl Stearate #21 support bounded rinse-off conditioning. Amino acids/humectants support hydration context but are not counted as a structural protein repair system. No rich silicone/quat/fatty-alcohol chassis supports high.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete declared formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Curl support is the dominant positioning but not a v1.4 focus enum. The mixed care/refatting/humectant system supports general care; do not force repair, volume or scalp-active from amino-acid or curl claims.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty default retained: shine and root-volume wording does not establish distinct independent product routes beyond the general care architecture.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Exact positioning concerns curls/waves, not sensitive or uncomfortable scalp. Aloe does not create a targeted scalp intent.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Ordinary rinse-out shampoo directions; no product-specific daily-use, reset or active-treatment trigger. Low cleansing alone does not set frequent.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: One substantive cationic-guar route with refatting esters and weak reset makes bounded deposition plausible; no silicone, butter or rich conditioner chassis supports high. Low is a realistic neighboring possibility because deposition amount is unknown; moderate is a provisional whole-formula call, not a polymer-presence rule.
